title: Longest Subarray Divisible by K with At Most One Negation I
statement: The problem asks for the longest subarray of an array (n ≤ 1000) whose sum is divisible by k, or becomes divisible after negating one element. Negating x turns the sum S into S − 2x, so a subarray qualifies when S ≡ 0 or 2x ≡ S (mod k). The small n allows O(n^2) enumeration with a running sum and a set of 2x mod k residues.
